newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,509 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,509 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 1,509 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 128 wheat contracts, 902 corn, 430 soybean, 41 soymeal, 4 soyoil and 4 oats futures contracts traded, along with 28 corn call, 23 corn put, 3 soybean call and 1 soybean put option.

The overnight trend for corn was down 1-1/2 to 3/4 cent per bushel, soybeans down 2-1/4 to 4-1/4 cents, wheat down 2 to 2-1/2 cents, soymeal down $1.10 a ton, soyoil down 0.04 cent per lb, and oats up 1/4 cent a bushel.
